profile.name: Menajul Hoque
profile.hometown_origin: Seuti Part 2 village, Cooch Behar District, West Bengal (PS Dinhata, PO Surkarur Kuthi) - an international border village situated near the India-Bangladesh border
profile.bio_summary: Menajul is a Data Engineer and Applied AI developer who bridges traditional enterprise data warehousing with modern AI systems. Currently an Associate Consultant at Capgemini, he works on enterprise cloud data pipelines (SAP Datasphere, BTP). In his personal capacity, he is an active indie developer building AI-powered web applications, secure cryptographic utilities, and mobile tools under his GitHub profile 'MinHackerz'. He grew up in Seuti Part 2, an international border-adjacent village in Cooch Behar, West Bengal near the India-Bangladesh border, studied at Jadavpur University, and is currently based in Kolkata.

education.degree: Bachelor of Engineering (BE) in Power Engineering
activities: Designed a 20MW Wind Power Station using MATLAB/Simulink
Developed a Simulink Model of Ocean Wave Energy Converter
education.pivotal_moment: Discovered SQL and Python during Power Engineering studies, realizing that modeling data systems was his true calling.

education.institution: Al-Ameen Mission (Residential) / Dangram I.C. High School
education.description: Completed Higher Secondary board examinations under Al-Ameen Mission (Residential) and Dangram I.C. High School, focusing on physics, chemistry, and mathematics.

Enrolled in intensive residential WBJEE/JEE coaching. Successfully qualified the West Bengal Joint Entrance Examination (WBJEE) and JEE Mains (Architecture stream), choosing to pursue Bachelor of Engineering at Jadavpur University.
Completed Secondary Education with first-class grades.

experience_history.description: Consulting on enterprise-level data architectures, data warehousing, and ETL integrations. Specializing in SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), SAP BODS, SAP Datasphere, SAP BTP, and SQL optimization.
Analyzed complex datasets, wrote Python validation scripts, and designed data pipelines. Focused on SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and relational SQL systems.
Automated analytical tasks and generated business reports.

volunteering.description: Cofounded a local relief organization during the COVID-19 pandemic. Actively supported approximately 30 elderly individuals in the community with daily necessities and medicines during the first few months of the outbreak.

creative_projects.title: পরের স্টেশন (Next Station)
creative_projects.description: An experimental animated short film exploring creative storytelling. The concept, story, and screenplay were written completely by Menajul. AI was utilized as a creative catalyst solely to design the visual textures and generate the ambient background audio score to match the narrative.
